Body.Content: The high-performance VPN gateway in Microsoft Azure provides higher bandwidth and more connections than the current virtual network VPN gateway. For more details about choosing VPN gateways, please refer to the Gateways section of the About VPN Devices for Virtual Network page. For more information, please visit the Azure Virtual Network page. For a comprehensive look at pricing, please visit the Virtual Network Pricing page.
